No, you are not correct. The number 9.11 is not greater than 9.9. To compare these two numbers, you look at the digits from left to right:

- Both numbers have a 9 in the ones place.
- The number 9.9 has a 9 in the tenths place, while 9.11 has a 1 in the tenths place.

Since 9 is greater than 1, 9.9 is greater than 9.11. Therefore, 9.11 is less than 9.9.
